module_summary: UDP transmit framer (64-bit): an FSM latches parallel UDP/IP header fields, emits the 8-byte UDP header word then forwards payload with length tracking and truncation, through a skid-buffered AXI-Stream output, passing IP header fields on.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Controller: idle, write header, payload, payload-last, wait-last; drives readies and output mux.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: UDP header valid; starts frame and header capture.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready from FSM-controlled register.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input UDP payload data forwarded to IP payload output.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid; advances word counting.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from registered FSM ready.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of input payload; detects early termination, returns to idle.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP header valid output set when header stored.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready clears header valid.

anchors.name: m_ip_length
anchors.why: IP total length computed as UDP length plus 20.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Representative passed-through Ethernet/IP header field output.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output IP payload: UDP header word then payload.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer register.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Latches all header fields into holding registers.

anchors.name: udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched UDP header field emitted in header word.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes; sets final tkeep and detects length mismatch.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds last payload word while discarding excess input.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Captures current output word into last-word registers.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output data mux: UDP header bytes, payload or last word.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready from output buffer gating FSM transfers.

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp slot for output data.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal data into output registers.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Payload ended before UDP length reached.

groups.name: Framing FSM
groups.description: Sequences header capture, UDP header word and payload forwarding.

groups.name: Header registers
groups.description: Latched IP pass-through fields and UDP header fields.

groups.name: Payload datapath
groups.description: Selects header word, payload or held last word for output.
